human_notes._source: jar (recipe graph). Gear mod: no entities, so no kill targets at all.
prep: simplyswords:runic_forge is the gate for everything interesting and is CHEAP — a smithing table plus obsidian, gold and an amethyst shard. It can be built long before netherite
Runic weapons consume a NETHERITE weapon of the same shape plus simplyswords:runic_tablet and diamonds, so full netherite is the real prerequisite, not the forge
order: 15 weapon shapes (longsword, katana, claymore, rapier, sai, spear, glaive, halberd, scythe, twinblade, warglaive, chakram, cutlass, greataxe, greathammer) exist in each vanilla material tier — the material ladder is ordinary iron -> gold -> diamond -> netherite
Then simplyswords:runic_tablet + netherite weapon -> the runic tier at simplyswords:runic_forge
The named uniques (simplyswords:bloodwake, :mjolnir, :livyatan, :harbinger, :soulkeeper, :stormbringer) sit above the runic tier and come from loot/relic upgrades, not the normal crafting ladder
key_drops: simplyswords:runic_tablet — the one item gating the whole runic tier
simplyswords:dormant_relic / :tainted_relic / :righteous_relic / :decaying_relic and simplyswords:empowered_remnant / :contained_remnant — the relic upgrade chain behind the unique weapons
traps: This mod ships item models under models/item/gobber_compat/... for the Gobber2 mod, which is NOT installed in this pack. Reading model paths as ids invents 317 fake ids such as a 'gobber_chakram'; only the 141 lang-backed ids are real
There are no simplyswords entities at all — do not write a kill task for this mod
